why: I compared each verifier check's PASS and FAIL conditions with the words of its expect line. Checks 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 mostly stay within those words. Check 4 does not. Expect line 4 says only "lint(text) in src/index.js is unchanged", but Check 4 fails the PR on "any diff in packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js", which it tests with `git diff --exit-code <base sha> HEAD -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js`. That is a file-scope rule: an edit elsewhere in the file that leaves lint(text) alone would fail. Check 4 also makes `node --test packages/jsonl-lint/test/lint.test.js` passing a PASS condition, which is a test the words don't require. The criterion says such stricter rules belong under Advisory, but here they are pass/fail conditions.
